description.summary: Quartz Desktop Workspace IPC and Compositor Interop

protocol.description: This protocol provides privileged workspace interaction services: - High-fidelity isolated window screenshot with transparent alpha and Apple dual-layer analytical shadow. - Quick Look 120fps expansion rectangle transitions between icon bounds and preview rect. - Magnetic Picture-in-Picture (PiP) docking, free positioning with Cmd, and side-tuck tabs. - Desktop Reveal ("Click Wallpaper to Reveal Desktop") spring window scatter and restore.

interface.name: zquartz_workspace_ipc_manager_v1

description.summary: Root workspace inter-process communication factory

interface.description: Factory interface for desktop daemons (qz-screenshot, qz-quicklook, qz-finder, qz-shell).

description.summary: Destroy workspace IPC manager

request.name: create_screenshot_session

description.summary: Create a screenshot capture session

request.description: Initiates an isolated capture session for Cmd+Shift+3, Cmd+Shift+4 or Cmd+Shift+5.

request.name: create_quicklook_session

description.summary: Create a Quick Look expand/collapse session

request.description: Connects the Quick Look daemon to compositor window coordinate tracking.

request.name: create_pip_controller

description.summary: Register a surface as a magnetic Picture-in-Picture window

request.description: Grants magnetic spring snapping, edge-tucking, and Cmd-free-positioning.

request.name: create_desktop_reveal_controller

description.summary: Acquire controller for Desktop Reveal state

request.description: Allows Finder and Shell to query and toggle Desktop Reveal window pushout.

interface.name: zquartz_screenshot_session_v1

description.summary: Isolated Screenshot and Screen Recording Session

interface.description: Handles high-precision captures with exact Apple shadow geometry and alpha blending.

description.summary: Screenshot targeting mode

entry.name: isolated_window
entry.summary: Camera mode (Spacebar): captures selected window with alpha + shadow

entry.name: menu_bar
entry.summary: Top menu bar or popover menu

description.summary: Shadow inclusion option

entry.name: include_shadow
entry.summary: Default: Apple dual-layer analytical Gaussian shadow on transparent PNG

entry.name: omit_shadow
entry.summary: Option held: Crisp window bounds without shadow penumbra

description.summary: Destroy screenshot session

request.name: capture_isolated_window

description.summary: Capture window texture with alpha and dual-layer shadow

request.description: Composites only the specified window onto a transparent backing buffer, including ambient occlusion and penumbra shadows generated by shadow_sdf.frag.

request.name: capture_region

description.summary: Capture custom rectangle with crosshair coordinates

request.description: Captures the exact rectangle on screen.

event.name: buffer_ready

description.summary: Captured image buffer ready in shared memory or DMA-BUF

event.description: Transfers the image file descriptor, dimensions, stride, and format to client.

arg.name: fd
arg.summary: Shared memory file descriptor containing raw BGRA8/RGBA8

description.summary: User cancelled screenshot (pressed Escape)

interface.name: zquartz_quicklook_session_v1

description.summary: Quick Look 120fps Rect Zoom and Anchor Daemon

interface.description: Computes the source icon bounds in Desktop/Finder coordinates and smoothly animates a 120fps spring zoom to the centered Quick Look window geometry.

description.summary: Destroy QuickLook session

request.name: request_expand_geometry

description.summary: Query source bounds of currently selected item

request.description: Compositor locates the active icon in Finder, Desktop, or Open/Save dialog.

request.name: animate_collapse

description.summary: Notify compositor to animate QuickLook window back into icon

request.description: Reverses the spring zoom animation when Quick Look is dismissed with Spacebar.

event.name: geometry_resolved

description.summary: Source icon bounding box resolved

event.description: Provides exact screen coordinates of the item icon for 120fps spring zoom origin.

interface.name: zquartz_pip_controller_v1

description.summary: Magnetic Picture-in-Picture Window Controller

interface.description: Enforces corner magnetism, edge collapse, and Cmd-modifier free positioning.

description.summary: Magnetic screen corners
Destroy PiP controller

request.name: snap_to_corner

description.summary: Magnetically snap PiP window to designated corner

request.description: Uses SpringParams::stage_manager() to animate into corner with 16px padding.

request.name: tuck_to_edge

description.summary: Hide video body off-screen leaving a pull tab

request.description: Pushes the PiP frame off the nearest display edge, revealing a floating chevron.

request.name: untuck

description.summary: Restore video body from tucked state

request.description: Animates video back into visible corner bounds.

description.summary: Window has magnetically settled in a corner

interface.name: zquartz_desktop_reveal_controller_v1

description.summary: Desktop Reveal ('Click Wallpaper to Reveal') Controller

interface.description: Manages smooth displacement of all application windows away from the center to reveal desktop stacks and wallpaper.

description.summary: Destroy reveal controller

request.name: toggle_reveal

description.summary: Toggle Desktop Reveal animation state

request.description: If active, scatters windows outward; if already scattered, pulls them back.

description.summary: Desktop reveal state transitioned

arg.name: is_revealed
arg.summary: 1 if desktop is revealed, 0 if normal
